name: Grok 4

lifecycle.note: grok-4-0709 retired from the xAI API; requests are served by grok-4.3.

replacedBy.note: grok-4-0709 redirects to grok-4.3 with low reasoning effort.

retired.note: Effective 12:00 PM PT on the xAI API.

relations.note: Editorial link along the main Grok line: the announcement describes Grok 4 as scaling up the reinforcement learning work begun with Grok 3 Reasoning, without calling it a successor.

summary.text: Grok 4 is an xAI reasoning model with text and image input, released on 9 July 2025 to SuperGrok and Premium+ subscribers and on the xAI API with a 256,000-token context window. xAI says it trained the model with reinforcement learning at pretraining scale and to use tools natively; a Grok 4 Heavy version came with a new subscription tier. It was retired from the API on 15 May 2026.

changes.text: xAI says it ran reinforcement learning at pretraining scale, with over an order of magnitude more compute than it had used before.
Trained with reinforcement learning to use tools natively, such as a code interpreter, web browsing and X search.
xAI describes the Grok 4 API as offering multimodal understanding of text and images; the grok-3 API model page listed text input only.
A Grok 4 Heavy version using parallel test-time compute was offered through a new SuperGrok Heavy subscription tier.

inputModalities.note: The announcement describes multimodal understanding across text and vision for the Grok 4 API.

features.note: Trained with reinforcement learning to use tools such as a code interpreter, web browsing and X search.

variants.name: Grok 4 Heavy
variants.note: xAI presents it as a version of Grok 4 that uses parallel test-time compute to consider several hypotheses at once; it was offered through the new SuperGrok Heavy subscription tier.

notes: API model id grok-4-0709 (named in the retirement guide); grok-4 and grok-4-latest were its API aliases. Grok 4 Heavy is kept as an inline variant because xAI presents it as a version of Grok 4 rather than a separate model. The announcement says Grok 4 was coming soon to hyperscaler partners; no primary source in this review confirms a date, so cloud-partner is left out. The model card (last updated 2025-08-20) covers Grok 4 API and Grok 4 Web. Lifecycle applies to the xAI API; no source states when Grok 4 left the consumer apps. No deprecation notice date is given. Output modalities are left out: the archived API model page that lists them could not be opened for this review.
